sourceSentences: The individual actives do not share a cooldown.

Once his main weapon's Moonlight is exhausted, it is moved to the end of the reserve queue; Alune then assembles his next available weapon from the reserve over 1 second, placing its Q on a 1.5-second cooldown from the start of the assembly. Aphelios cannot cast Phase during the assembly.
While at lower than 10 Moonlight, casting his Q will not spend additional Moonlight but instead consume all the remaining points.
Changing weapons while Moonlight Vigil is in flight does not change the effect it has when it hits.
Spell shield will block Moonlight Vigil's initial detonation damage but does not prevent the attacks from locking-on.
Increases the initial slow to 99% and empowers Binding Eclipse to root targets affected by the enhanced slow for 1.35 seconds.
Aphelios expunges all enemies with Gravitum's slow debuff, dealing magic damage and rooting them for 1 second.
An enemy affected by Gravitum, or an in-flight Gravitum projectile, is required to cast this ability. In-flight projectiles will be empowered to apply Binding Eclipse's effects to their targets.

Aphelios unleashes a wave of energy in a cone in the target direction over the cast time, dealing physical damage to all enemies hit and locking onto each of them. After 0.25 seconds, Aphelios then fires a volley of attacks at each locked-on target from his current off-hand weapon, dealing 100% AD physical damage and applying on-hit effects.
Aphelios cannot cast Phase nor Moonlight Vigil during Onslaught, but he is still able to move.
Onslaught begins firing with Aphelios' off-hand weapon. This means that, if used with Crescendum, it will generate n/2 Chakrams for even numbers of hits.

Attacks alternate between Severum and his current off-hand weapon, each dealing AD physical damage, affected by critical strike modifiers, and applying on-hit effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness.
You land your long-range Q with Calibrum, then swap into Gravitum and root them immediately after. This is one of your higher single target
You fire Infernum's Q into a group and with Severum as your off-hand, you convert that damage into a huge heal.
You hit multiple targets with Infernum Q, then swap into Gravitum and root everyone that was hit.
So, if you plan ahead, you can Q, swap, Q again, and swap again, chaining multiple abilities in seconds. You can chain up to four weapons if you plan your ammo correctly.
With Severum, one small trick is saving your last bit of ammo. If you leave it just before it runs out, you can switch back later for one last queue
With Gravitum, it sets up crowd control across multiple targets. With Infernum, it explodes in massive AoE damage.
Your ultimate isn't just about pressing R, it's about what weapon you're holding when you use it.
